Cau 1 (2.0d): Mo ta muc dich va pham vi cua du an. Key: neu ro muc tieu + pham vi. Cham: du muc tieu va pham vi 2.0d; chi 1 trong 2 cho 1.0d.
Cau 2 (2.0d): Phan tich 3 rui ro chinh va bien phap ung pho. Key: rui ro ngan sach / nhan su / thay doi yeu cau. Cham: moi rui ro day du (nguy co + xac suat + ung pho) 0.66d.

papers.answer_text:
Request 1: The project aims to build an internal grading system for exam papers. Its scope covers uploading student papers, distributing them to lecturers, AI-assisted grading and reporting.
Request 2: Firstly the team may run over budget on cloud servers. Secondly a freelancer may leave mid-project which risks the timeline; we can keep documentation to mitigate. Thirdly the customer may change requirements.
